title: Launch Monitor Ball Speed Club Leaderboard
dataSources: Golf rounds (`golf:round`), Garmin golf telemetry (`garmin:golf`), UDisc rounds (`udisc:round`), launch-monitor shots (`launchmonitor:shot`), handicap-index updates (`handicap:index`).
app: Arccos and Garmin S62 round telemetry, UDisc round exports, launch-monitor CSVs, and handicap-index updates streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted imports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=launchmonitor:shot
| stats avg(ball_speed_mph) as avg_value max(ball_speed_mph) as peak_value count as sessions by club
| sort - avg_value
description: Ranks club values by average and peak ball speed in miles per hour, helping you see where launch monitor ball speed performs best.
value: A simple leaderboard is an easy way to see which club contexts are producing the strongest outcomes without deep analysis.
implementation: Populate `club` consistently from your export pipeline so the leaderboard can compare like with like.
visualization: Leaderboard table of club, average ball speed in miles per hour, and peak ball speed in miles per hour.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors which club areas give you the strongest launch monitor ball speed results.
